name: SDA Tranche 1 Transport Layer A
slot_a_text: This is the 6th flight for B1103. It flies back to Landing Zone 4 rather than a drone ship. Its previous trip was Starlink Group 17-49, 54 days ago.
slot_b_text: SpaceX's 117th launch of the year, 736th all time. It works out to a launch every other day. No Falcon 9 has failed in 338 flights. It is the 237th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year.
description: Tranche 1 Transport Layer A is one of six missions by the United States Space Force Space Development Agency (SDA) for the Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA) Tranche 1 Transport Layer constellation, which will provide assured, resilient, low-latency military data and connectivity worldwide to the full range of warfighter platforms from Low Earth Orbit satellites. The constellation will be interconnected with Optical Inter-Satellite Links (OISLs) which have significantly increased performance over existing radio frequency crosslinks.
rocket_fact: The soot on a landed Falcon 9 is rarely cleaned off fully, giving flight-proven boosters a distinct dirty look.
